items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 03 July 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the southwest of Ireland.


##Wind##

Westerly 2 to 4, backing Southwest around midday, then increasing South or Southwest 4 or 5 this afternoon, occasionally touching 6 in the east of the area this evening and overnight. Veering West or Southwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain soon developing, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, occasionally touching 6 in the east of the area for a time.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate until later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
